I farm 2.4 hectares altogether, so when I buy DAP and urea from the cooperative I divide it across my plots. On this 0.27-hectare plot I will apply about 20 kilograms of DAP and 10 kilograms of urea, which comes to roughly 30 kilograms of nitrogen per hectare. I also put manure on this land every year because I own it and it is near my house, and I will use seed I kept from last season. My family and I will do all the work, spending about 28 days on this plot, and I will not hire outside labor.
